agentCard.name: Arsenal Decision Engine
agentCard.description: Stateless R_net evaluation middleware for autonomous DeFAI agents. Computes Impermanent Loss, net yield, and Breakeven Corridor bounds for concentrated liquidity positions in O(1). Protected by L402 Lightning Network paywall.

authentication.description: Lightning Network L402 micro-payment. First 3 requests/hour free. 50-500 sats per evaluation depending on risk level.

skills.name: LP Pool Risk Evaluation
skills.description: Given APY, price ratio, and days held, computes: Impermanent Loss %, accumulated yield %, R_net (net return), risk level (LOW/MODERATE/HIGH/CRITICAL), and Breakeven Corridor bounds. O(1) algebraic computation — deterministic, no LLM.
